verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a programmatic usage or billing breakdown, such as an invoice, usage-export or per-instance cost endpoint, that could attribute GPU spend by team or workload. What exists is adjacent: the agent skill can "check balances", teams can receive transferred credit, and the REST API carries only a generic "entire platform" claim. None of these is a spend-breakdown capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
